gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8516 covers electrothermic appliances of a kind used for domestic purposes; subheading 8516.71 names coffee or tea makers; chapter 85 note 1 does not exclude it
GRI 6: 8516.71.00 then statistical suffix .20 automatic drip and pump type (assumed; percolator is .40, other .60)

rejected_alternatives.reason: other coffee makers; default drip type assumed
commercial hot-beverage preparation machinery; description says a coffeemaker, assumed household

missing_facts: Type of coffeemaker (drip, percolator, other) only affects the 10-digit suffix
classification.rationale: All coffee makers fall in 8516.71 at the 6-digit level, so the missing facts only affect the statistical suffix. Assumed an automatic drip household unit. H88216 appeared in search as a similar-ruling hit for 8516.71.00.20; I did not read its full text.
